assertions.name: all_4_candidates_have_verdicts
assertions.source: Diagnostic probe enumerates 4 candidates with explicit verdicts

description: DIAGNOSTIC: tests whether c_3 cross-anchor swing fits a complex-c_3(q) Habiro fibre object. Enumerates 4 projection rules + 3 complex-c_3 candidates; reports structural fit OR refutation. NOT a candidate-fishing run.

candidate_1_im_delta.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE — q_proton and q_muon differ by only ~1e-8 in absolute terms, so the ratio test has little discriminatory power. δ(q_proton) ≈ 7× δ(q_muon) but the anchors are nearly identical — suggests δ is NOT a simple power of ℏ_q (which would give a near-unit ratio). Could be due to numerical noise in the empirical c_3 extraction at this precision.

candidate_3_re_im_via_bar_decomp.form: bar-decomposition sym/antisym = Re/Im of complex Δtr_M
candidate_3_re_im_via_bar_decomp.verdict: REFUTED. If sym and antisym were Re/Im, then |Δtr_M|² = sym² + antisym² should hold. Instead: sum_squares = 1.733e-2, |Δtr_M|² = (sym+antisym)² = (−0.1421)² = 2.019e-2. Ratio = 0.858 ≠ 1. The bar-decomposition is NOT a Re/Im split of a complex Δtr_M. It IS the eigenspace decomposition under the bar-involution acting on a REAL function — different from complex conjugation of a complex function.

candidate_4_re_projection_minus_2.form: c_3 = Re[fibre c_3(q)], Im part unobservable at u^3 order
candidate_4_re_projection_minus_2.verdict: REFUTED — empirical c_3 at q_proton = -2.0693 NOT -2. If Re[c_3] were exactly -2 and Im were the deviation, the u^3 projection would give -2 exactly. The observed deviation IS AT u^3 order, ruling out the Re-only projection of c_3 = -2 + i·δ.

data.overall_conclusion: Complex-c_3 framing PLAUSIBLE structurally but specific candidates REFUTED by data. Bar-decomposition is NOT Re/Im of complex Δtr_M (sum-of-squares mismatch). Anchors too close to discriminate. The fibre/observable distinction (PR #1616) stays correct as discipline guard; complex-c_3 attack needs wider-spaced anchors to be testable.
data.recommended_next_step: Either (a) construct a third q-anchor at a different observable (e.g., m_e/m_K) for wider spacing, OR (b) examine the Habiro q-difference equation directly for Im content rather than relying on numerical c_3 extraction at near-identical anchors.
